# RewardsPro development tools

[Module map](../README.md) · [Source directory](../../../apps/rewardspro/tools)

Provide webhook simulation, shop inspection and scenario-running tools for local RewardsPro development.

**Scope:** Nested support package outside the root workspace. Some commands send requests or inspect databases; command availability is not permission to run them against a service.

**Placement:** Nested package outside the root workspace; package `rewardspro-dev-tools`.
